U1.descr: Nordic nRF54LM20A-CAAA WLCSP-61, body 3.020 x 2.430. Land centres measured from Nordic nRF54LM20x-CAAA reference layout rev 0.2 (nrf54lm20x_caaa_ref_pcb_0_2.pdf p1 pads, 0.2 mm round, pitch 0.325; p11 and p12 body outline 3.020 x 2.430); ball names from nrf54lm20x_caaa_ref_schematic_0_2.pdf p1; top view, A1 top left. 59 balls on the 0.325 grid (rows A B D E F G H, columns 1 2 4 to 10), C1 (ANT) and D3 (VSS) off the grid. Nordic package drawing (HTML only, behind a bot check) not obtained: ball height and tolerance not read
source: p1 pads; p11 and p12 body outline (schematic names: nrf54lm20x_caaa_ref_schematic_0_2.pdf p1)

U2.descr: Nordic nPM1304-CAAA CSP-35, body D 3.0775 x E 2.3775 (npm1304_datasheet_v1_0.pdf p155 Figure 55 and Table 35): 7 x 5 balls, pitch d 0.419 along the 7 columns, e 0.44 along the 5 rows, ball b 0.225 nominal (0.195 to 0.255); balls A1..E7 as p153 Table 33 and p152 Figure 53 top view (A1 top left). X1.descr: Kyocera CX2016DB crystal 2.00 x 1.60 x 0.40 (w1_kyocera_cx2016db_catalog_page10.pdf p1 (page 9 of the 77-page Kyocera crystal units catalogue cry_e.pdf): dimensions, recommended land pattern four 0.9 x 0.8 pads, centres 1.4 across and 1.1 down; connection (top view): crystal on #1 and #3, #2 marked GND, #4 not connected). X2.descr: TXC 9HT11-32.768KDZC-T 32.768 kHz crystal, 2 pads, 2.0 x 1.2 x 0.6 (w1_txc_9ht11_datasheet.pdf p1, T11 series: '2 pads surface mount package'). The one-page TXC sheet has no drawing, so the pad numbers are not printed: the two terminals of a crystal are interchangeable: pad 1 = X1 net, pad 2 = X2 net
source: p1 (pads of X2); TXC p1 (2 pads, 2.0 x 1.2 x 0.6)

J1.descr: Hirose FH35C-15S-0.3SHW(50) FPC connector, 15 contacts 0.3 pitch in two staggered rows (w1_hirose_fh35c_series_catalog.pdf p3 dimensions A 6.1, B 3.6, C 4.2, p4 recommended land: pads 0.3 wide, 7 pads 0.65 long at 0.6 pitch (even pins) and 8 pads 0.8 long at 0.6 pitch (odd pins), rows 3.6 apart outer edge to outer edge, two metal-fitting pads 0.4 x 0.95 each 0.5 from the end pad centre; w1_hirose_fh35c-15s-0.3shw50_drawing.pdf p1: pin 1 is the right end of the odd row, pin 2 the right end of the even row, numbering goes left with 0.3 steps). Courtyard (W2, design/wiring/ring-board-plan.md f.4 and h.1): the closed housing, A 6.1 along the contact row (catalogue p3) by depth (3.35) (catalogue p3 top view, lever closed; the (4.2) of the p3 detail drawing is the lever standing open, only while the tail is plugged in before assembly), centred on the land pattern, and widened in depth to the outer land edges, B 3.6 (catalogue p4), because the land rows reach 0.125 beyond the 3.35 housing on each side: 6.1 x 3.6. Pads MP are the two mounting pads (no signal)
source: p3 dimensions, p4 recommended land; w1_hirose_fh35c-15s-0.3shw50_drawing.pdf p1 (numbering)
